documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Management reported strong financial growth for FY 2025-26, with consolidated total revenue rising to 17,600.71 lakhs and standalone total revenue reaching 17,110.06 lakhs. Net profit on a standalone basis increased by 23.48% to 1,150.97 lakhs. The company engaged in capital raising activities through preferential convertible warrants and addressed procedural observations regarding corporate social responsibility by transferring funds to the PM CARES Fund. Sheetal Universal Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, noting a decrease in revenue from operations to Rs. 10,56,747 thousand and an increase in profit after tax to Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: The company notes that the outlook for the industry remains positive, with strong demand projected for domestic and international markets in the coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook for the industry remains positive, with strong demand projected for the coming years, both in domestic and international markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that there is a lot of potential demand for the coming years as the company operates in agriculture-based products.
demand_outlook.quote: As ours is the agriculture based products, there is lot of potential demand for the next years.

capex_expansion.claim: New machineries were installed to provide better results and to cope with changing industry requirements.
capex_expansion.quote: New machineries were installed to provide better result and to cope up with changing requirement of the industry.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed an IPO during the year and looks for new products and machinery for expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Also company is come up with IPO in f.y. 2023-24 and looks for new products and machinery for expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Initiatives are being taken by the company to improve quality standards and reduce costs at appropriate levels.
margins_costs.quote: The initiatives are being taken by the Company for improving the quality standards and reduction of costs at appropriate level.

margins_costs.claim: Total operating expenses for the financial year 2023-24 were Rs. 1,271,979 thousands compared to Rs. 1,267,295 thousands in the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: The operating Expenses of Rs. 1271979 thousands during FY 2023-24, as compared to previous financial year 2022-23 incurred of Rs. 1267295 thousands.

margins_costs.claim: Depreciation expenses for FY 2023-24 stood at Rs. 8,232 thousands compared to Rs. 6,331 thousands in FY 2022-23.
margins_costs.quote: The depreciation Expenses of Rs. 8232 thousands during FY 2023-24, as compared to previous financial year 2022-23 incurred of Rs. 6331 thousands showing decrease as compared to previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Finance costs for FY 2023-24 were recorded at Rs. 14,355 thousands compared to Rs. 9,232 thousands in the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: The finance cost of Rs. 14355 thousands during FY 2023-24, as compared to previous financial year 2022-23 incurred of Rs. 9232 thousands.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 20.05% as compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 20.05 % as compared to previous year

margins_costs.claim: The net profit after tax of the company decreased by 0.23% compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The net profit after tax of the company decreased by 0.23% with compared to previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allotted 14,20,000 convertible warrants on a preferential basis.
capital_allocation.quote: Pursuant thereto, the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on Friday, 1st May, 2026, allotted all 14,20,000 (Fourteen Lakh Twenty Thousand) Convertible Warrants to the Proposed Allottees belonging to the “Promoter/Promoter Group” and “Non-Promoter” category, upon receipt of 25% of the Warrant Issue Price, i.e., ₹52.50 per Warrant, in accordance with the terms approved by the Members.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved the allotment of 2,61,000 equity shares following the conversion of warrants.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on Thursday, 23rd July, 2026, approved the allotment of 2,61,000 (Two Lakh Sixty-One Thousand) fully paid-up Equity Shares of ₹10/- each, pursuant to conversion of 2,61,000 Convertible Warrants (out of the total 14,20,000 Warrants) by allottees belonging to the “Non-Promoter/Public” category, upon receipt of the balance 75% of the Warrant Issue Price, i.e., ₹157.50 per Warrant, aggregating to ₹4,11,07,500/- (Rupees Four Crore Eleven Lakh Seven Thousand Five Hundred).

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has not recommended any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026

capital_allocation.claim: The company retained the entire amount of profit for financial year 2025-26 in the statement of profit and loss.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors have decided to retain the entire amount of profit for F.Y. 2025-26 in the Statement of Profit & Loss as at March 31, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Rs. 0.5 per equity share of face value of Rs. 10 for the year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To consider and recommend Final Dividend of Rs. 0.5/- (i.e. 5% per share) per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- for the year ended March 31, 2025 for the financial year ended 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided to retain the entire amount of profit for financial year 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors have decided to retain the entire amount of profit for F.Y. 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss as at March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, after considering holistically the relevant circumstances and keeping in view the Company’s dividend track, has decided that it would be prudent, not to recommend any Dividend for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: During the year, the company came up with an IPO of 34,00,000 equity shares at an issue price of Rs. 70 each.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, your Company was come up with IPO of 34,00,000 (thirty four lacs) equity shares at an issue price of Rs.70/- each by member’s approval dated 28th August, 2023.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that profitability is affected by factors such as raw material prices, availability of agricultural produce, and export market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company operates in the Agro Industry and its profitability is affected by various factors including raw material prices, availability of agricultural produce, export market conditions, foreign exchange fluctuations, operating costs and prevailing market conditions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Major fluctuations in the Rupee price value corresponding to raw material price movements and stringent market conditions can affect the company's performance.
risks_headwinds.quote: Major fluctuations Rupee price value corresponding to fluctuation in the raw material price and stringent market conditions can affect the company's performance.

risks_headwinds.claim: Product risk, raw material price fluctuations, government policies, and financial risk can impact the company and require continuous follow up.
risks_headwinds.quote: Product risk, risk of fluctuation in the raw material price, government policies, and financial risk can affect the company, which requires continuous follow up.

management_commitments.claim: Outstanding convertible warrants remain eligible for conversion into equity shares within 18 months from the date of allotment.
management_commitments.quote: As on the date of this Report, 11,59,000 (Eleven Lakh Fifty-Nine Thousand) Convertible Warrants remain outstanding and are eligible for conversion into equity shares within 18 (eighteen) months from the date of allotment, i.e., on or before 30th October, 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated it will ensure CSR obligations are planned, monitored, and complied with within prescribed timelines in subsequent financial years.
management_commitments.quote: The Management has taken note of the matter and will ensure that the CSR obligations are duly planned, monitored and complied with within the prescribed timelines in subsequent financial years.

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning to operate on a larger scale and achieve the highest portion of market demand for its products as a long-term planning strategy.
management_commitments.quote: As a long-term planning strategy, company is planning to operate on a larger scale and achieve the highest portion of market demand of its products.

management_commitments.claim: Mrs. Kajal Hiren Patel is proposed to be re-appointed as a director liable to retire by rotation at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.
management_commitments.quote: Mrs. KAJAL HIREN PATEL (DIN: 07267381), director of the company, who retires by rotation be and is hereby re-appointed as director of the company liable to retire by rotation

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
